artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Source only; no deploy is in this cell's scope. S05: emits one ObservationRow per expected account per (valuation_date, knowledge_date) carrying exactly the 22 valuation.history_fields (AC1); joins to b00 canonical_valuation by (account_id, business_date) to the cent (AC2), refusing a missing (AC3) or duplicate (AC4) canonical row; accepts and ignores the 7 rejected_substitutes (AC5); splits expected/covered/unresolved with the pre-filter denominator preserved (AC6-AC8, AC13); delegates the membership-interval question entirely to taxsma_membership.resolve_date_status (AC9-AC10); carries business_active_accounts through unchanged (AC11); computes complete_value only when fully resolved (AC12); derives a stable, event-keyed observation_id (AC14-AC15); applies the Gold partition NO_CHANGE/CORRECTION_QUEUED policy (AC16); resolves an acyclic correction chain and aggregates across every partition before counting (AC17-AC19); gates the SMA source-basis (AC20); and computes the Gold key at one call site (AC21).

22 tests (test_ac1_ .. test_ac21_, one per criterion, plus one structural forbidden-call-site test); synthetic account keys only (minted through _key()). No live route, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, BD roster, b00 or real S3/boto3 call in this suite. py -3.12 -m pytest ... -q: 22 passed in 0.5s.

The probe for all 21 criteria: each AC runs its named pytest subset in a fresh subprocess (never in-process), requires rc 0 AND at least one test collected (a 0-of-0 run is a refused vacuous pass), and prints exactly one VERDICT line. Mirrors the TX-m-2 probe's structure (same repo, same pattern).
This order's result record: every value with its instrument, UTC time and denominator; it rides the commit that carries this instance.
